# Support

This project treats maintainer sustainability as a project infrastructure cost, not as a private exception to the value charter. The maintainer is part of the life community that the project says it serves.

Support is welcome only when it preserves the project's evidence boundaries, criticism channels, and governance independence.

## What Support May Cover

Support may help cover:

- AI/API quota and model access used for review, validation, documentation, and release work.
- Continuous integration, compute, storage, bandwidth, backups, and security tooling.
- Devices, repairs, network access, and local development infrastructure.
- Independent review, red-team work, legal/accounting review, and governance support.
- Maintainer time, recovery time, attention, documentation labor, release work, and basic living support.

No public payment link is declared in this repository at this time. Do not send private financial details, personal addresses, phone numbers, or payment credentials through GitHub issues.

## What Support Cannot Buy

Support, sponsorship, or a commercial license cannot buy:

- factual conclusions;
- evidence grades;
- mechanism conclusions;
- merge rights;
- governance vetoes;
- roadmap control;
- privacy access;
- suppression of criticism;
- exemption from red-team review;
- preferential treatment in validators, reports, or claim ceilings.

Positive claims must still be tied to evidence, version, test scope, and boundary conditions. Negative feedback is not treated as an attack when it exposes a real gap.

## Non-Commercial Use

Personal learning, education, independent non-commercial research, public-benefit review, criticism, and compatibility exploration remain intentionally low-friction within the current license scope.

Older versions and forks that were already received under MIT keep the rights granted by those old MIT versions. The current layered license applies to current and future licensed versions; it does not revoke already granted MIT rights.

## Commercial Production Use

Commercial production use requires a separate commercial license or written reciprocal agreement when the current license scope requires it.

Commercial support does not promise features, delivery dates, endorsements, findings, governance power, or return on investment. It is a resource relationship, not a truth relationship.

## Signal Channels

Use the issue forms for three different kinds of external signal:

- independent review or red-team feedback;
- non-commercial use reports;
- sponsorship or commercial licensing inquiries.

These signals are recorded separately. A use report is not an independent review. Sponsorship interest is not evidence that the project is correct. Public attention such as stars, views, likes, reposts, or friendly comments does not replace real review, real use, or real resource commitment.
